mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shifts (store_id, terminal_id, cashier_id, status, opening_cash) VALUES (#{storeId}, #{terminalId}, #{cashierId}, #{status}, #{openingCash})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM shifts WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM shifts WHERE terminal_id = #{terminalId} AND status = 'OPEN'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cash_movements (shift_id, type, amount, reason, created_by) VALUES (#{shiftId}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{reason}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cash_movements WHERE shift_id = #{shiftId} ORDER BY id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS sales_count, COALESCE(SUM(total), 0) AS gross, COALESCE(SUM(discount_total), 0) AS discount, COALESCE(SUM(tax_total), 0) AS tax FROM sales WHERE shift_id = #{shiftId} AND status IN ('COMPLETED', 'REFUNDED')

SELECT p.method AS label, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS amount FROM sale_payments p JOIN sales s ON s.id = p.sale_id WHERE s.shift_id = #{shiftId} AND s.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'REFUNDED') GROUP BY p.method
SELECT type AS label, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM cash_movements WHERE shift_id = #{shiftId} GROUP BY type
